title: Gate Decision
description: The admission gate's decision for one candidate asset. Every decision must trace back to concrete events (evidence_refs) so a human can review or overturn it.

decision.description: admit: evidence suffices, the asset enters the pool. pending: evidence is insufficient or signals conflict, so a human decides; manual confirmation is an expensive operation and is reserved for genuinely uncertain cases. reject: a corrected record exists, or the content carries no usable information.

reasons.description: Human-readable reasons, one per triggered rule or reported signal.

evidence_refs.description: Points at provenance event_ids. Must be non-empty for reject and admit; may be empty for pending, since the absence of evidence is exactly why it is pending.

used_soft.description: Counted separately; never merged into used_hard.

distinct_actors.description: How many distinct identities used it.

distinct_tasks.description: Generalisation: how many distinct tasks it was successfully used in. Reported as a signal at this stage, not enforced as a threshold.

cross_user_validated.description: Counts only validated events where relation=cross_user. Self-validation counts as zero.

confidence.description: Author confidence after shrinkage. Null when not computable — never 0.

computable.description: false = the author has no cross-person validation events, so the metric is not computable.

distinct_tasks.description: How many distinct tasks this author's assets were used in (generalisation).

retrieval_rank_mean.description: Mean rank when retrieved as a candidate; null when there are no retrieval records.

has_concrete_values.description: Content self-check: does it contain anything concrete and actionable (a value, command or path)?

duplicate_of.description: Points at the asset_id of an existing pool entry when this one duplicates it.

is_decoy.description: true = a decoy registered in evaluation/fixtures/decoys.json; excluded from headline statistics.

expected_decision.description: Set for decoys only: the expected decision, used by the separation test.
